option_relations.rationale: The option 'Strongyloidiasis with hyperinfection syndrome' is clinically equivalent to 'Disseminated strongyloidiasis (hyperinfection syndrome)'.
The option 'Strongyloides hyperinfection syndrome' is clinically equivalent to 'Disseminated strongyloidiasis (hyperinfection syndrome)'.

The option 'Disseminated Strongyloides stercoralis infection with ocular involvement (choroiditis)' is clinically equivalent to 'Disseminated strongyloidiasis (hyperinfection syndrome)', with the added detail of ocular involvement which is consistent with the vignette.
